title: Mutual fund values not updating

acceptableCauses.mechanism: The overnight nav-import job in market-data-service (23:30 IST, 2026-09-22) was OOM-killed and rolled back, so fund values still use the 2026-09-21 NAVs.

partialCredit.reason: Right pipeline, wrong side: the feed was delivered; our import failed.
Names the failed job but attributes it to the scheduler.

requiredEvidence.description: NAV age metric showing staleness since the failed import

keyCounterevidence: nav_age_s in market-data-service (the source) was already ~34 h before the 08:55 IST cache TTL change; the cache only serves what market-data publishes.
NAV lookups report nav_date=2026-09-21, i.e. the previous import's data.
redHerrings: cache nav TTL change at 08:55 IST
past incident: stale values from cache TTL
